```{r}
library(tokenizers)
library(gutenbergr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidytext)
```

```{r}
unclevanya <- gutenberg_download(c(1756)) 

tidyuncle <- unclevanya |> 
  unnest_tokens(word, text) |> 
  anti_join(stop_words)

print(tidyuncle)
```
